name: Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy Revisions
description: Extends the Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy field to support referencing revisions.
project_description: Submodule of Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy that adds a revision-aware hierarchical field type, entity_reference_hierarchy_revisions, on top of the Entity Reference Revisions module. It combines EntityReferenceRevisionsItem with the parent module's EntityReferenceHierarchyItemTrait (adding the depth column) so a tree can reference specific entity revisions rather than current entities. It ships a matching autocomplete widget, a Nested Rendered entity formatter that reuses the parent module's outline/nested-list rendering, and config schema inheriting the Entity Reference Revisions storage and formatter settings. This is the field type the Paragraphs submodule targets.
